corrections.name: Instant Rise
corrections.why: The individual XV2 skill source explicitly gives 300 Stamina and All races/Skill Shop access. A broader Evasive table elsewhere has inconsistent generalized cost language; the repository retains the individual XV2 skill value.

corrections.name: Final Pose
corrections.why: The current Xenoverse reference explicitly describes Final Pose as an Evasive requiring 300 Stamina, and the current skill-ID corpus lists it as a CaC skill. Batch 235's 200 value came from an inconsistent category-side record.

corrections.name: Mach Dash
corrections.why: The current Xenoverse reference explicitly describes Mach Dash as an Evasive requiring 300 Stamina. Batch 235's 200 value came from an inconsistent category-side record.

systemic_finding: Do not use the generic Xenoverse 2 Evasive statement that all Evasives cost 300 Stamina as a blanket rule; several current XV2 skills demonstrably use 200 Stamina. Resolve costs from the individual XV2 skill record or corroborated skill-ID data.
